digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: Gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml that run repo scripts without if-present guards hard-fail when the checked-out change tree predates the script's introduction because Gerrit's Verified lane uses workflow definitions from the target branch but checks out the change's tree.

Nine unguarded gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml golden-path job run scripts that were added after the oldest open changes, causing false CI failures indistinguishable from real gate violations.
Running an unguarded step's command against a tree lacking the script exits with errno 2 (file not found) and produces a hard CI failure.
All 11 enumerated unguarded gate steps must be wrapped with early-return guards that skip with a log line when the script is absent, preserving gate enforcement when the script is present.
A structural guard mechanism is needed to prevent future instances by detecting and failing on any step in patchset-lane workflows that runs a repo script without the if-present guard convention.
